resources.string: Uploads finished rides to your own Strava account – only if you connect it here. Without a connection, everything stays on your device.
After you finish a recording, in the background, as soon as you are online.
The ride’s name, track, times, elevation and heart rate are uploaded. Who can see it on Strava depends on your Strava privacy settings.
Trailscape will stop uploading and forget its access. Rides already uploaded stay on Strava.
Strava did not grant access. Nothing was connected.
Without the “upload activities” permission Trailscape can’t upload anything. Connect again and keep that box ticked.
The Strava sign-in expired or didn’t match. Please connect again.
Connecting to Strava failed. Check your internet connection and try again.
No browser found to open the Strava sign-in.
The device’s secure storage isn’t available. Trailscape can’t store the Strava access.
This ride is already on Strava.
Strava isn’t accepting uploads right now. Try again later.
Access to Strava is no longer valid. Reconnect under Settings → Strava.
